items.title: HSBC downgrades Akamai to hold, cuts target price to $123
items.summary: Investing.com -- HSBC downgraded Akamai Technologies to Hold from Buy and cut its target price to $123 from $171, citing weaker cloud infrastructure margins and slower long-term growth. The new target implies 3.8% upside from the $118.55 share price as of Aug. 6.

items.title: AKAM Q2 Deep Dive: Cloud Infrastructure Commitments Drive Revenue, Margin Pressures Emerge
items.summary: Cloud technology company Akamai Technologies (NASDAQ:AKAM) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 5.4% year on year to $1.1 billion. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $1.12 billion was less impressive, coming in 1.4% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.59 per share was 0.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
